t: You're looking at Energy Sculpture, in Friendship Gardens. Very little is recorded about it, so I'll say only what's known. It was made by three fashion designers: Marjan Krnjic, Joseph Sraka, who is a Slovenian model and designer, and Tia Anna Paynich. It is an unusual piece of work from people better known for fashion than for sculpture, and it's worth a slow look before you move on.
